s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute respiratory symptoms with obstructing tracheal mass
salient_findings: Polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Mass causing obstruction of main bronchi
key_facts: 48-year-old white man
Lifelong non-smoker
Remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier
Three-month history of mild hemoptysis and cough
Non-tender subcutaneous mass on left forearm
Normal vital signs
Oxygen saturation of 94% on room air
Normal laboratory studies
Chest CT scan showed polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Flexible bronchoscopy revealed mass arising from anterior tracheal wall
Mass caused 80% obstruction of right main bronchus and 70% obstruction of left main bronchus
Lesion resected bronchoscopically with electrocautery

shortlist.label: Tracheal carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: History of remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid and current presentation with obstructing tracheal mass

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute respiratory symptoms with obstructing tracheal mass, a common presentation for this tumor type

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Obstructing tracheal mass and history of hemoptysis, although less likely given the patient's non-smoking status

shortlist.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tracheal mass with obstructive symptoms, a possible diagnosis given the tumor's location and presentation

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute respiratory symptoms and obstructing tracheal mass, with a possible inflammatory component

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of remote bronchoscopic resection of a tracheal carcinoid and the current lesion's histology, with large nests of eosinophilic cells within a collagenous and myxoid matrix, is consistent with a carcinoid tumor.

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: No specific histological features mentioned that are typical of adenoid cystic carcinoma

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No mention of squamous cell characteristics in the histology

rejected.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
rejected.why: No indication of mucin production or epidermoid components in the tumor

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: The histological description does not match the typical features of inflammatory myofibroblastic tumors
